scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,server -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --prefix apps/web" "npm run dev --prefix apps/server"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix apps/server && npm run build --prefix apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix apps/server && npm run test --prefix apps/web && npm run test:e2e
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix apps/web && npm run lint --prefix apps/server
